boot.versionMismatch: The server and web contract versions don't match — server {server} · web {web}.
boot.versionFixServer: The server is older than the web app. Update the server and restart it (if you run from source, restart after `uv sync --all-packages`).
boot.versionFixWeb: The web app is older than the server. Reload the page. If this keeps showing, rebuild the web app (`pnpm --filter @agent-console/web build`).
boot.versionFixUnknown: If this keeps showing after a reload, restart the server (after `uv sync --all-packages` if you run from source) and rebuild the web app.
